target: PHP 8.5.10 CLI NTS 64-bit, raw eval profile
scope: parse-eval only; native parse-only gate and checked PHP-Parser AST remain mandatory

focused_service.mixed_error_negative: Native accepts 'echo 1; namespace N; class self {}'; PHP-Parser reports namespace-first plus reserved-class errors, so the worker returns helper_unsupported without AST. Raw probe: .tools/mixed-error-probe.php.

private_runtime_bridge.exact_native_model: 5/5 static rejections, including no preceding echo
private_runtime_bridge.limit: Private bridge against the then-frozen eval candidate, not installed canonical runtime evidence. Original source bytes and raw process output are kept in the ignored report path.

limits: Native parser acceptance does not authorize arbitrary PHP-Parser recovery. Only complete ASTs with exclusively authenticated namespace structural errors are admitted; other disagreement is helper_unsupported. The parser service does not execute eval or include, and this file-syntax gate is not an eval-source corpus.
